project_type: Pulse — self-hosted uptime monitoring. Go (gin) API + scheduler + WS hub backend with embedded SvelteKit static SPA; separate pulse-mcp Go binary.
build_system: Backend: go build/test (modules in backend/go.mod). Frontend: pnpm (frontend/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml) — run `pnpm install` first on a fresh checkout. SQL: sqlc (backend/sqlc.yaml) generates into backend/internal/store/postgres/ from queries/*.sql; never hand-edit *.sql.go. Migrations: golang-migrate, embedded via backend/migrations/migrations.go, auto-applied at startup.
test_framework: Backend: go test -race (plus pgregory.net/rapid property tests). Frontend: Vitest + fast-check + @testing-library/svelte.
build_command: Backend: cd backend && go build -o /dev/null ./cmd/pulse. Frontend: cd frontend && pnpm build.
test_command: Backend: cd backend && go test -race -count=1 ./... . Frontend: cd frontend && pnpm check && pnpm validate-locales && pnpm test .
verification_instructions: Mirror .github/workflows/pull_request_opened.yml. backend/** -> `cd backend && go test -race -count=1 ./... && go build -o /dev/null ./cmd/pulse`. SQL/migration -> `cd backend && sqlc generate` then confirm `sqlc diff` is clean. frontend/** -> `cd frontend && pnpm install && pnpm check && pnpm validate-locales && pnpm test && pnpm build`. openapi.yaml must stay in sync with handlers in the SAME change. DB-gated TimescaleDB tests run ONLY after a successful `pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -t 3` preflight, via `PULSE_RUN_DB_TESTS=1 go test ./internal/store/timescale/...`; with no DB, run WITHOUT the flag (tests skip) and state integration tests were skipped — never claim they passed.
snapshot_or_generated_files: sqlc generated code under backend/internal/store/postgres/ (produced by `cd backend && sqlc generate`; config backend/sqlc.yaml). After regenerating, `sqlc diff` must be clean. heartbeat_events is NOT sqlc-managed — it is accessed only via raw pgx in backend/internal/store/timescale/, like check_results.
environment_constraints: GNU `timeout` is not installed on macOS by default — rely on the tool timeout, not a bare `timeout` wrapper. Postgres/TimescaleDB on localhost:5432 comes up via `make dev-local`; preflight with `pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -t 3` before any DB-gated command and never loop a DB command against an unreachable DB. Dev servers/watchers (make dev, pnpm dev) must run in the background, never as a blocking foreground step. Set working directory via the tool cwd, not a leading `cd`; write each command as one unbroken line.
contribution_requirements: No AI attribution in commits; conventional commits. OpenAPI (backend/api/openapi.yaml) is the source of truth — any endpoint/schema change must update it in the same commit. All user-visible frontend strings MUST use t() from $lib/i18n; add keys to en.json first then every other locale (English placeholder OK). Use CSS custom properties from app.css (never hardcoded Tailwind palette classes), dark mode via [data-theme="dark"] (never the dark: prefix). Commit locally on branch feat/heartbeat-timeline; never push.
key_patterns: Timescale store methods follow CheckPoint/WriteCheckResult/QueryHistory in store.go (raw pgx, parameterized, make([]T,0) slice init). Monitor history handler history.go is the template for the heartbeat history handler (INVALID_ID, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR for from/to, INVALID_STEP for step in [60,86400], 24h default window, retentionClamp, make([]...,0,n) never null). Retention service.go runCycle pages ListMonitors{Limit,Offset}, terminates on len(page)<batchSize, maxConsecutiveBatchErrors=3, per-item log+continue, raw pool.Exec DELETE ... WHERE id IN (SELECT ... LIMIT deleteLimit). Error envelope {"error":{"code","message"}}; X-Request-ID via middleware. The ping writer/evaluator writer seam is injected as a TRAILING positional constructor param; a nil writer is valid and skips the write (like nil hub/dispatcher). afterTransition in ping.go is the SINGLE side-effect site for both Success("up") and Fail("down"); the event write lives there once. markDown in evaluator.go writes exactly one 'missed' event at the guarded MarkHeartbeatDown transition. Retention column mirrors monitors migration 011 (NOT NULL DEFAULT 30, CHECK 1..365); error code for out-of-range retention is INVALID_RETENTION_PERIOD (matches monitors.go). Frontend StatusTimeline.svelte is the visual MODEL but is legacy-styled (hardcoded colors + English) — the new HeartbeatTimeline.svelte deliberately diverges to CSS vars + t().
